Only official files remain for all three elections, so election night cannot be judged from the live site. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). tag_rationale: Only the Nov 2024 general is determined (END, from the archived precinct report uploaded at 1:18 AM CST on election night), so by the fixed rule the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: Wayback capture 20241106132230 (7:22 AM CST Nov 6) of 'November 5, 2024 Statement of Votes Cast--Unofficial Final.pdf'. The archive records the county server's original Last-Modified as 'Wed, 06 Nov 2024 07:18:16 GMT' (1:18 AM CST, election night); PDF CreationDate D:20241106003918-06'00'; page footer 'Precinct Summary - 11/06/2024 12:37 AM 1 of 2,809 Report generated with Electionware'. Page 1 header (font-shifted text, decoded): 'Summary Results Report General and Special Election November 5th, 2024 SOVC 117 of 117 Voter Centers Reporting Collin County UNOFFICIAL RESULTS PCT 001'; columns 'TOTAL VOTE % Election Day Early Voting Ballot by mail Limited'; row 'Rep Donald J. Trump/JD Vance 1,032 54.26% 119 886 27 0'. So per-precinct candidate votes including election-day votes were uploaded on election night. Only this one precinct file is known; earlier election-night precinct postings, if any, were not archived, so the result is END. County totals: 'Combined Election Day and Early Ballots--Accumulated Totals-Unofficial Final.pdf', original Last-Modified 'Wed, 06 Nov 2024 06:40:17 GMT' (12:40 AM CST), printed 11/06/2024 12:24 AM.

2026_runoff.fact: The Results Archive keeps only 'Precinct Results Report - Official Totals', 'Summary Results Report - Official Totals', an official export CSV and reconciliation forms for the May 26, 2026 runoff; no election-night files remain. Check 3 pending. Targeted pass: the 7:17 AM CDT May 27 Wayback capture of the results page lists 'May 26, 2026 - Primary Runoff Election - Election Night Precinct Report - Unofficial Final' and 'Election Night Summary Report - Unofficial Final'. The summary report (county totals) was archived: PDF CreationDate D:20260526225944-05'00', printed 05/26/2026 10:58 PM. The precinct report was never archived and the county copy now returns HTTP 404, so its upload and run times are unknown; a title is not a time (rule 47), and county totals alone cannot show precinct numbers were absent (rule 43). Stays UNDETERMINED.
